title: I Took the Church Coffee-Hour Signup to the Deacon Who Never Poured

parts.text: I arrived at 10:42 a.m. to make coffee because the signup had my name. The deacon, Ray, was already drinking from an urn he had started early and not refilled. The sheet, which Ray administers, said if you drink, you brew. I was fifty-one, holding a can of grounds. He said leadership tastes first. I photographed the sheet, the empty backup urn, and his mug. Then I put the grounds back in the cupboard and sat. At 10:48 the fellowship hour opened to a dry spigot and a line of kids.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: Kids are in line at a dry spigot and Ray still has a mug.

social.video_title: Leadership tasted first and left the backup urn empty — Part 1/2
social.description: Signup name, grounds in hand, dry fellowship. Would you have brewed anyway?

parts.text: Ray brewed. I initialed that he had. The sheet now has a poured column. Kids got juice that existed. I drink after I brew. Leadership is a can opener. The cupboard stayed unlocked. Sunday smelled like coffee instead of excuse. I kept my name on future weeks because I like the work when it is work. Empty urns preach louder than Ray.

social.video_title: The sheet grew a poured column — Part 2/2
social.description: He brewed, kids drank, names stayed honest. Was tasting first a refill?
